title: AC1024 rooted associative network/variable document output

scope.source: Source-authored dx_data graph in tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp; no external DWG/DXF fixture file.
scope.graph: NOD -> one DICTIONARY -> root ACDBASSOCNETWORK -> one owned ACDBASSOCVARIABLE.

implementation.summary: Admitted the bounded root network/one-variable AC1024 graph through source identity reservation, recursive dictionary/action closure, planned/emitted handle remapping and whole-file publication. Added subclass-aware associative DXF parsing for action owner/body, network counts/action references and variable fields. Unknown or extra subclass fields invalidate the typed-complete profile; DXF parsing does not set the DWG-only variable wire-complete flag.
implementation.transaction: A late mutation before OBJECTS emission preserves the preexisting destination and permits corrected retry. An unresolved owned-action target is refused atomically and succeeds after correction on the same adapter.
implementation.fixturePolicy: Test graph is authored in code; no DWG or DXF fixture files were added.

proof.emittedWire: A low-level group-pair scan independent of DRW_AssociativeObject::parseCode checks the exact ASCII and binary ACDBASSOCNETWORK and ACDBASSOCVARIABLE group order, common owner/reactor roles, owning-network and action-body references, action counts, target handle, class/value fields and variable flags.
proof.readback: Fresh fileImport confirms dictionary membership/owner closure, remapped network identity, reactor and root owning-network references, one owned action targeting the remapped variable, network subclass fields, variable ownership and all selected variable strings/value/flags.
proof.fixedHandleCollision: The source network uses handle 0xD; output remaps it and all references resolve to the remapped identity. The source-handle reservation control also checks a generated LINE against an associative source identity equal to its baseline handle and exercises a fixed-handle source identity.
proof.failureRetry: For both ASCII and binary output, the selector checks late mutation rollback, corrected export retry, unresolved action-target refusal with destination sentinel preserved, and corrected retry on the same adapter.

limits: This qualifies only a source-authored AC1024 root network with one owned, fully consumed ACDBASSOCVARIABLE using the selected integer value profile in ASCII and binary DXF output.
The physical mechanical AC1024 ACDBASSOCVARIABLE witness remains ineligible while its body suffix is unclassified.
Other associative bodies, dependencies, action parameters, registry versions and descendants remain unqualified and strictly refused when required.
This does not establish complete associative source coverage, native CAD semantics, LibreCAD/FreeCAD consumer behavior, 3D support or any general DWG/DXF support claim.
nextAction: Select the next physical-source-backed required associative body or edge; prove its bounded fields and roles before extending the graph output profile.
